_doc: Per-project nightly config for swarm/nightly.mjs. Keys MUST be project ids from ../projects/registry.json — nightly.mjs refuses to run anything unregistered. 'local' is the checkout the worker clones (leading ~ and $HOME are expanded; paths are per-machine). 'setup' steps run before the tests (e.g. dependency install). 'test' is the command under test. Binaries are validated via PATH at submit time; plans carry bare command names (the tool jail rejects absolute paths outside the work dir), so workers resolve them through the daemon's PATH — keep the daemon's PATH sane (e.g. /usr/local/bin for forge). Optional 'release': {command, args} declares the repo's real release command for CAP_RELEASE-gated release workers (project.release) — leave it out until the project has a real one.
